sets.title: Forming the Conditional
sets.description: Build conditionals with past tense + бы
sets.descriptionRussian: Образуйте условное наклонение: прошедшее время + бы

items.prompt: How do you form the conditional in Russian?
items.promptEnglish: How do you form the conditional in Russian?
items.hint: The conditional always uses a past tense verb form
items.explanation: Russian conditional = past tense + бы. Example: хотел бы (would want).

items.prompt: Он _____ бы тебе. (He would help you.)
items.promptEnglish: He would help you.
items.explanation: Conditional: помог бы (past masculine of помочь + бы).

items.prompt: Мы _____ бы рады вас видеть. (We would be glad to see you.)
items.promptEnglish: We would be glad to see you.
items.explanation: Conditional: были бы (past plural of быть + бы).

items.prompt: Она _____ бы по-русски. (She would speak Russian.)
items.promptEnglish: She would speak Russian.
items.explanation: Conditional feminine: говорила бы.

items.prompt: Дети _____ бы мороженое. (The children would eat ice cream.)
items.promptEnglish: The children would eat ice cream.
items.explanation: Conditional plural: ели бы (past of есть 'to eat' + бы).

items.prompt: Я _____ бы книгу. (I would read a book.)
items.promptEnglish: I would read a book.
items.explanation: Conditional: прочитал бы.

items.prompt: Ты _____ бы с нами? (Would you go with us?)
items.promptEnglish: Would you go with us?
items.explanation: Conditional: пошёл бы (masculine). Feminine would be пошла бы.

explanations: Masculine: хотел бы (he would want / I [male] would want)
Feminine: хотела бы (she would want / I [female] would want)

blanks: Я _____ бы чай. (I would like tea.)
Она _____ бы помочь. (She would like to help.)
Они _____ бы в парк. (They would go to the park.)
Он _____ бы это сделать. (He would be able to do this.)
Мы _____ бы рады. (We would be glad.)
hints: Я (male) would like - masculine past of хотеть
Она would like - feminine past of хотеть
Они would go - plural past of пойти
Он would be able - masculine past of мочь
Мы would be - plural past of быть
explanations: Хотел бы: masculine past of хотеть + бы.
Хотела бы: feminine past of хотеть + бы.
Пошли бы: plural past of пойти + бы.
Мог бы: masculine past of мочь + бы.
Были бы: plural past of быть + бы.

sets.title: Если бы (Hypothetical If)
sets.description: Build if-clauses with если бы... бы
sets.descriptionRussian: Составляйте условные предложения с если бы... бы

items.prompt: Если бы я _____, я бы сказал. (If I knew, I would say.)
items.promptEnglish: If I knew, I would say.
items.hint: After если бы, use past tense
items.explanation: Если бы + past tense: если бы я знал (if I knew).

items.prompt: Если бы у неё _____ машина, она бы поехала. (If she had a car, she would drive.)
items.promptEnglish: If she had a car, she would drive.
items.hint: Feminine past of быть (машина is feminine)
items.explanation: Если бы была машина: conditional with feminine noun.

items.prompt: Если бы мы _____, мы бы пришли. (If we could, we would come.)
items.promptEnglish: If we could, we would come.
items.explanation: Если бы мы могли: plural past of мочь.

items.prompt: How many бы appear in a full если-conditional sentence?
items.promptEnglish: How many бы appear in a full если-conditional sentence?
items.explanation: Both clauses get бы: Если бы я знал, я бы сказал.

items.prompt: Если бы он _____ русский, он бы всё понял. (If he knew Russian, he would understand everything.)
items.promptEnglish: If he knew Russian, he would understand everything.
items.explanation: Если бы он знал: past masculine of знать.

items.prompt: Мы бы пошли гулять, если бы погода _____ хорошей. (We would go for a walk if the weather were good.)
items.promptEnglish: We would go for a walk if the weather were good.
items.hint: Погода is feminine, past tense after если бы
items.explanation: Если бы погода была хорошей: feminine past of быть.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если я знал, я бы сказал.
errorCorrection.explanation: Hypothetical 'if' requires если бы (not just если).

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы я знаю, я бы сказал.
errorCorrection.explanation: After если бы, use past tense (знал), not present (знаю).

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы я знал, я скажу.
errorCorrection.explanation: Both clauses need бы + past tense. Скажу is future, not conditional.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы она могла, она помогает.
errorCorrection.explanation: The main clause must also be conditional: помогла бы (past + бы).

sets.title: Gender Agreement in Conditional
sets.titleRussian: Согласование по роду в условном наклонении
sets.description: Match past tense gender to the subject
sets.descriptionRussian: Согласуйте прошедшее время с родом подлежащего

items.prompt: Маша _____ бы помочь. (Masha would help.)
items.promptEnglish: Masha would help.
items.explanation: Feminine subject = feminine past: помогла бы.

items.prompt: Время _____ бы быстрее. (Time would pass faster.)
items.promptEnglish: Time would pass faster.
items.explanation: Neuter subject = neuter past: прошло бы.

items.prompt: Друзья _____ бы с нами. (Friends would go with us.)
items.promptEnglish: Friends would go with us.
items.explanation: Plural subject = plural past: пошли бы.

items.prompt: Молоко _____ бы вкуснее с мёдом. (Milk would be tastier with honey.)
items.promptEnglish: Milk would be tastier with honey.
items.explanation: Neuter subject: молоко было бы.

items.prompt: Сестра _____ бы книгу. (Sister would read a book.)
items.promptEnglish: Sister would read a book.
items.explanation: Feminine subject: прочитала бы.

items.prompt: Брат _____ бы тебе. (Brother would call you.)
items.promptEnglish: Brother would call you.
items.explanation: Masculine subject: позвонил бы.

blanks: Он _____ бы по-английски. (He would speak English.)
Она _____ бы нам. (She would write to us.)
Дети _____ бы молоко. (The children would drink milk.)
Письмо _____ бы быстрее. (The letter would arrive faster.)
Я (female) _____ бы с удовольствием. (I would come with pleasure.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Gender and number agreement in conditional forms

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these conditional forms by gender/number

sets.title: Polite Requests with Бы
sets.description: Use conditional for polite wishes and requests
sets.descriptionRussian: Используйте условное наклонение для вежливых пожеланий и просьб

minimalPairs.explanation: Direct statement: Я хочу (present tense, not conditional).
Polite/conditional: Я хотел бы (past + бы = softer request).

minimalPairs.context: Вы _____ мне помочь? (Direct: Can you help me?)
Вы _____ мне помочь? (Polite: Could you help me?)
minimalPairs.explanation: Polite: Вы могли бы? (conditional = softer, more polite).

translation.hint: Polite request with хотел бы + infinitive
translation.explanation: Хотел бы + infinitive = polite 'would like to'.

translation.hint: Very polite with не + могли бы
translation.explanation: Не могли бы is extra polite (literally 'couldn't you').

translation.english: I would like to find out.
translation.hint: Хотелось бы is another polite form (impersonal)
translation.explanation: Мне хотелось бы: impersonal conditional, very polite.

translation.english: I would be glad to. / I'd love to.
translation.explanation: Я бы с удовольствием: a polite way to accept an invitation.

items.prompt: Если бы я _____ деньги, я бы купил машину. (If I had money, I would buy a car.)
items.promptEnglish: If I had money, I would buy a car.
items.hint: After если бы, use past tense
items.explanation: Если бы + past: имел бы (had, hypothetical).

items.prompt: Что бы вы _____? (What would you do?)
items.promptEnglish: What would you do?
items.explanation: Что бы вы сделали? Past plural (вы) + бы.

items.prompt: Я бы _____ раньше, но пробки. (I would arrive earlier, but traffic.)
items.promptEnglish: I would arrive earlier, but traffic.
items.explanation: Conditional: приехал бы (would arrive).

items.prompt: Она _____ бы нас, если бы могла. (She would visit us if she could.)
items.promptEnglish: She would visit us if she could.
items.explanation: Conditional feminine: навестила бы.

items.prompt: Мне _____ бы узнать ваше мнение. (I would like to know your opinion.)
items.promptEnglish: I would like to know your opinion.
items.hint: Impersonal polite form: мне хотелось бы
items.explanation: Мне хотелось бы: impersonal conditional, very polite.

items.prompt: Если бы _____ лето, мы бы поехали на море. (If it were summer, we would go to the sea.)
items.promptEnglish: If it were summer, we would go to the sea.
items.hint: Лето is neuter, past of быть
items.explanation: Если бы было лето: neuter past of быть (лето is neuter).

errorCorrection.explanation: Conditional uses past tense (хотел), not present (хочу), with бы.
Conditional requires past tense: сделала бы (not future сделает).
Бы cannot start a clause. Correct: Я бы помог тебе.
